name: Murat Demir
bio:
Murat's journey in motorsport began unexpectedly after a university project designing suspension systems caught the eye of a local rally team. Leaving his initial plans for a career in aerospace, he immersed himself in the high-octane world of racing, quickly rising through the ranks due to his sharp analytical skills and ability to troubleshoot under pressure. He joined Prema Racing after years of experience in different racing teams.

As Chief Engineer, Murat emphasizes a collaborative and data-driven approach. He believes in empowering his team, fostering open communication, and leveraging cutting-edge technology to gain a competitive edge. Murat's meticulous nature and knack for identifying subtle performance gains are what sets him apart, often uncovering critical improvements that others miss.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with slight thinning on top
physical.description: A man of medium build with a serious, focused demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on a specific brand of Turkish coffee before every race.
